device.name: AD-SDL Digital Twin centrifuge bimanual OpenArm Mimic environment

facts.text: The registered gym id Isaac-Centrifuge-Bimanual-OpenArm-IK-Abs-Mimic-v0 uses entry point rpl_centrifuge.openarm.mimic_env:CentrifugeBimanualOpenArmIKAbsMimicEnv and env cfg rpl_centrifuge.openarm.ik_abs_mimic_env_cfg:CentrifugeBimanualIkAbsMimicEnvCfg

The action tensor is 16-dimensional: [0:3] is the left arm position, [3:7] the left quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw), [7:8] the left gripper, [8:11] the right arm position, [11:15] the right quaternion and [15:16] the right gripper, with positions in the robot root frame
Both gripper channels are scalars in [0, 1], consumed by the binary joint-position action
The arm actions are absolute target poses: both terms use command_type pose with use_relative_mode=False and differential IK with the dls method
The binary gripper actions drive the finger joints to 0.044 for open and 0.0 for close
The environment runs sim.dt=0.01 s (100 Hz) with decimation 5, so one environment step spans five physics steps
The termination terms are time_out at the episode length, tube_dropped when the tube root is below _SURFACE_Z - 0.30 m, and success once the tube has stayed inside the bucket for 3.0 s
No reward manager is configured: rewards, commands and curriculum are None

Observations are grouped into policy, an empty rgb_camera group and subtask_terms; the policy group holds joint positions and velocities, last action, left/right end-effector poses and tube/bucket poses

A reset randomizes the pickup station in x/y by (-0.03, 0.03) m and yaw by (-0.15, 0.15) rad, drops the tube into one of four rack wells from 0.15 m above the rack, and shifts the bucket in x/y by (-0.03, 0.03) m
The Mimic wrapper adds get_robot_eef_pose, target_eef_pose_to_action, action_to_target_eef_pose, actions_to_gripper_actions and get_subtask_term_signals to the ManagerBasedRLMimicEnv base
The package is an external Isaac Lab 3.0.0 task extension that bundles USD assets and registers its gym ids on import
The prerequisites are Ubuntu 22.04+ with a recent NVIDIA driver and Isaac Sim 6.0.0 or 6.0.1

The upstream README calls the scene geometry (robot mount and prop positions) and the XR anchor and retargeter offsets starting points that need in-sim tuning and cannot be validated without the GUI or a headset
The task pack also contains SO101 physical leader-arm-over-USB variants and a GR1T2 variant
The rendering script launches an Isaac application before importing rpl_centrifuge and supplies parse_env_cfg's result as cfg to gym.make

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the fake's placeholder start offsets and the step path is deterministic; the upstream RNG, USD scene and PhysX dynamics are not reproduced

gaps: fake-only package: the inherited live gymnasium.make fallback is refused; the SO101 physical leader-arm-over-USB variants and GR1T2 task are not served
kinematic/analytic stand-in only: no physics, contacts, actuator, sensor or noise model; step echoes the action and advances a tick counter

the 16-element action layout follows the upstream docstring, but the arm position and quaternion bounds are placeholders, not the upstream action space; only the two gripper channels are stated as [0, 1] upstream
the observation is a 16-element echo of the last action, not the upstream Dict groups (policy, rgb_camera, subtask_terms); joint, end-effector and object dimensions are not modelled
the termination terms are not modelled: the fake never reports success or tube_dropped; it truncates at the derived 600-step episode length (30.0 s divided by the 0.05 s control step)
reset start offsets are placeholders drawn from a seeded Python RNG, not the upstream USD scene or its documented reset randomization ranges
the Mimic helper methods are not implemented; the fake provides only reset, step, close and the Gymnasium action/observation spaces
the fake was not compared with the upstream environment, which needs Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, torch and a GPU

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the fake world stops advancing: the latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset; the last fake state stays readable; no stop of Isaac Sim or physical equipment is claimed
